questions.question: Micah gave back the silver he had taken from his mother. What did she want the silver made into?

answers.text: A graven image and a molten idol
A gold lampstand for the tabernacle

questions.question: A young Levite left Bethlehem in Judah because a man named Micah sent for him. True or false?
Micah asked a young Levite to stay and be his father and priest. What did Micah offer him in return?

answers.text: Ten shekels a year plus clothes and provisions
Two hundred shekels and a house of his own
A field and a share of the flocks

questions.question: After a young Levite became his priest, Micah said the LORD would be good to him. Why was Micah so sure?

answers.text: Because a Levite had become his priest
Because his mother had blessed him by the LORD
Because the silver had gone back to his mother
